name: standard
description: About 40 minutes a build: model behaviour on 128 prompts first (it also heat-soaks the hardware), closed loops at 1, 4 and 16 streams (60 s warm-up, 300 s measured, a paired decode verdict each), cold real-text prefill at 8K, 32K and 128K, and decode stalls of four streams during a 32K prefill. No engine grid: it needs a server that times its own steps.
